```sql
SELECT 
    strftime('%Y-%m', fecha) AS mes,
    ROUND(
        CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN estado = 'cancelado' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*),
        4
    ) AS tasa_cancelacion
FROM pedidos
WHERE fecha >= '2026-01-01' AND fecha <= '2026-04-30'
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', fecha)
ORDER BY mes;
```
